limits: This page is a fixture: every record behind it is invented for the test, and no line here is a fact about the WESM reserve market or the real ERC case.

The fixture exists because the real case's copies carry no evidence of access, so no cutoff places a clause there. The fixture keeps that shape and invents the evidence, so the whole path is shown once, end to end.
The dates, fingerprints, offsets and fetch times are invented with it; nothing was fetched, read from a document, or produced by a model.
The dependency walk returns one accepted edge because the fixture accepts it; the real case's own mapping is still proposed, and the page says so there.
